data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Al means 'exalted' or 'noble'. In Christianity, it is a name derived from the Hebrew biblical figure El, the chief God of the ancient Canaanites, who was later absorbed into the Abrahamic God. This name is often used to signify kindness, faith, and loyalty.
